split.strategy: chronological disjoint target blocks; crossing horizon windows purged
split.validation_strategy: first half tune, second half calibration
split.weights_fit_on: train only; no refit after tuning

warnings: Prediction intervals use horizon-wise absolute residual quantiles on disjoint calibration data. Overlapping time-series windows are dependent; nominal coverage is not guaranteed and can fail under drift.
Models and scalers are frozen at the training block. Later observed values condition rolling forecasts without refitting.
The test set is a one-time evaluation. Repeated tuning against test metrics requires a fresh future holdout.
